source_title: WHO Global Health Observatory: Number of indigenous malaria cases
claims_checked: Country-year indigenous malaria counts in supplied 2000–2015 compilation; selected Azerbaijan values
evidence_found: Indexed WHO GHO records surfaced values including Azerbaijan 2000=1,526; 2001=1,054; 2002=505; 2005=242; 2006=141; 2007=108; 2012=3; 2015=0.
limitations: The legacy GHO/Athena interface now states it is retired. The exact archived release used by the supplied compilation is not recorded, and this review could not independently confirm all 880 country-year rows against one dated extract. Indexed values are partial corroboration, not a complete audit. Duplicate aliases for Czech Republic/Czechia (CZE) and Turkey/Türkiye (TUR) were found in the supplied table; the duplicate all-missing rows were consolidated to one canonical ISO3-year record each.
action: Keep source-reported values and add row-level validation status; do not describe the full series as independently verified. Duplicate ISO3-year keys were checked; non-conflicting alias duplicates with all-missing case values were consolidated, and the app now blocks remaining duplicate ISO3-year keys.

claims_checked: WHO European Region reported zero indigenous malaria cases in 2015
evidence_found: WHO report summary explicitly states that for the first time WHO began tracking, the European Region reported zero indigenous cases in 2015.
limitations: A regional milestone does not independently validate every country-year observation in the compilation.
action: Use to support the 2015 regional milestone only; do not use as a substitute for a country-year data extract.

source_title: Mammadov et al. (2016), Elimination of Plasmodium vivax Malaria in Azerbaijan
source_type: Peer-reviewed country elimination review using national and WHO materials
validation_status: event claims checked; some dates and case count require qualification
claims_checked: Azerbaijan financing, IRS scale-up, LLIN distribution, Global Fund support, electronic surveillance, lab network, primaquine campaign, cross-border coordination, 2012/2013 case milestones and ABER
evidence_found: Article reports Eni contribution US$760,000 agreed in 1999 for a three-year plan; IRS scale-up to 1.25 million people in the 2005 policy narrative; 50,000 LLINs in 2009–2012; Global Fund support from 2009; electronic reporting since 2009; 233 laboratories; >10,000 people in seven districts reached by primaquine MDA in 2011; 2 indigenous of 3 total cases in 2012; no indigenous case from 2013; ABER >4% in 2013–2014.
limitations: Retrospective review, not an independent implementation or financial audit. The article does not specify the exact end year for Eni’s three-year plan or a year for the 233-laboratory count. Its 2012 indigenous count conflicts with the supplied WHO GHO compilation.
action: Corrected/qualified intervention records; unresolved 2012 case count remains withheld from map values.
